issues.description: The solution marks Course.addRating(stars:) as private while the template and problem statement expect a normally accessible instance method (the template declares it without an access modifier). Additionally, Client.swift (in the solution) calls swiftCourse.addRating(...). Making the method private prevents callers in other files from invoking it and will cause compilation errors or confusion for students who follow the template/problem which imply the method is callable.
issues.suggestedFix: Make addRating(stars:) have the same accessibility as in the template/problem (i.e., remove the 'private' modifier so it is internal/public and callable from Client). Alternatively, if the method should be intentionally restricted, update the problem statement and template to reflect the restricted visibility and provide a public API for adding ratings.
